newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks flat to weak in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks flat to weak in London.

text.p: .Japanese shares were flat to weaker in quiet trading in London.
The Nikkei 50 was down 20.24 points to 1,400.11 in London at 1527 GMT, unaffected by surging share prices across Europe and in the U.S., dealers said.
The only point of interest was in shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd, they said.
Nomura shares remained under pressure in London after news that the group admitted that two of its executives were involved in illegal securities trading.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 average fell 232.18 points to 18,041.33. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
